programme.desc: Steve discovers his heartbeat with a stethoscope -- and Blue has discovered something too. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue has discovered.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Oh no! It's a hot summer day and Blue and Steve are composing a list of friends to invite to our pool party, but there's someone we forgot to invite! We play Blue's Clues to figure out who's missing from our list.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We spend the entire episode outdoors enjoying nature and playing Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to play. We identify herbs and help Mr. Salt and Paprika put together a bouquet, go on a walk, and play "I Spy."

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: We're playing Blues Clues because we want to know what Blue invented. Steve wants to invent something, too, but he keeps inventing things that already exist!

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Something kind of silly's going on at Steve and Blue's house and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what makes Blue laugh.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Steve and Blue are going on a big trip! We play Blue's Clues to figure out where Blue wants to go. As we search for clues, we pack for our trip and learn about new environments.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: It's Blue's costume party and lots of silly spooky things are happening! Magenta doesn't have a costume, so we play Blue's Clues to help her figure out what to wear.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: It's a special nighttime game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do tonight. As we search for clues we join Shovel and Pail for a game and learn about the animals who are awake while we are asleep.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue is feeling shy, so we play Blue's Clues to figure out what she is feeling shy about. Along the way, we meet Pail's friend Sifter and Miranda, who lives with Magenta. We help Shovel figure out how to play with Sifter.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Magenta Gets Glasses: It's a big day -- Magenta is getting glasses! We launch into a game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Magenta will be able to do when she gets her glasses.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Imagine Nation: With a shape made out of two chairs and a blanket, Steve is imagining there's an igloo in the living room! But Blue sees something different.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: The Anything Box: Steve and Blue found an empty box in the backyard. They figure out that if we imagine, we can use the box to play rocket ship. We blast off -- and play Blue's Clues.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Adventure!: Sir Steve-a-lot and Queen Blue must rescue King Horace from Periwinkle, the castle keeper! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what we should imagine ourselves to be.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Superfriends!: It's a bird, it's a plane -- it's the Blue's Clues Superheroes! Steve, Blue, Tickety and Slippery are all being superheroes today.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: The Baby's Here! (aka Blues Big News): Anticipation builds as we wait for Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper to call from the hospital to tell us that the new baby's here! And what should we give the baby? Blue knows!
programme.sub-title: The Baby's Here! (aka Blues Big News)

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's New Place: Blue decides to create a special space for herself in the bedroom. What's going to be her favorite thing to do in her special space? We play Blue's Clues to figure it out.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What's Inside?: Steve and Blue discover a locked trunk inside their bedroom closet. What could be inside? We play Blue's Clues to figure out where the key is so we can open the trunk.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper Day: Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper do so much for us that Blue and Steve create an impromptu holiday to celebrate them both -- "Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper Day."
programme.sub-title: Mr. Salt and Mrs. Pepper Day

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: What's New, Blue?: Steve and Blue are inspired to create a newspaper to tell everyone what's new around the house. Ee play Blue's Clues to help Steve search for news.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Bugs!: To the untamed wilderness of our backyard we go! Join Steve and Blue on a bug-watching expedition and help to play Blue's Clues as we figure out what Blue's favorite bug is.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: ¡Un Día Con Plum!: A visit from Plum gets us learning new Spanish words. Meanwhile, we play Blue's Clues to figure out what kind of marioneta Blue thinks Plum and Periwinkle should make.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Making Changes: The arrival of a new baby in the house means making some adjustments. We play Blue's Clues to figure out an additional way to assist Salt and Pepper in taking care of Cinnamon

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Something To Do Blue: Blue can't decide what to do today. Mr. Salt encourages us to pick a few items from around the house and use our imaginations to invent something new to do with them.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Book Nook: Blue is organizing the books in her book nook. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to read about.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Let's Boogie: Steve's got sneakers on today and that makes him feel like dancing! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to make a dance about.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blocks: Blue's friend Green is over today and we're playing with blocks. Steve is making a playground for his cow figurines and Blue is building a really tall tower.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Hop on board our cardboard bus and help Steve pick up our friends for a day of pretend school, where Blue is the teacher! We play Blue's Clues to figure out where we'll be going.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Rhyme Time: If you've got a rhyme, we've got the time today, Steve is a poet and he knows it - and so are we! We play Blues Clues to figure out what Blue wants to rhyme about.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Blue's Backyard Ballgame Bonanza: If it's round and rolls, there's a good chance it belongs in Blue's Backyard Ballgame Bonanza. We're inventing all sorts of new ballgames today.

programme.title: Blue's Clues
programme.desc: Today we're using charts to measure all sorts of things. Mr. Salt needs to figure out what everyone's favorite snack is so he can make them, so we make a chart to help him out!

programme.title: South Park: Le Bruit Marron
programme.desc: Un énorme concert de flûtes à bec dirigé par Yoko Ono et réunissant les enfants de tous les États-Unis doit se dérouler dans l'Arkansas.

programme.title: South Park: Inqualifiable crime de haine
programme.desc: Les filles défient les garçons à la luge. Les garçons acceptent, certains de gagner grâce au cul de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: La Petite Fée des Dents
programme.desc: Cartman se réveille et découvre que la fée des dents lui a apporté 2 dollars pour sa dent de lait. Il décide alors de chercher plein de dents pour s'acheter une console.

programme.title: South Park: Quintuple contorsionniste
programme.desc: Le cirque vient d'arriver à South Park. Le numéro des Quintuplés contorsionnistes donne envie aux enfants de faire un numéro.

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Lors de l'interro de début de cours, Timmy, un nouvel élève handicapé ne sait pas répondre. Il est alors envoyé chez la principale. Les médecins lui diagnostiquent un déficit aigu de l'attention, qui le prive de devoirs.

programme.title: South Park: Pip!
programme.desc: Cet épisode spécial est consacré à Pip, personnage très spécial inspiré d'un roman de Charles Dickens intitulé 'Les Grandes Espérances'. Pip est un jeune forgeron et va devoir trouver une solution pour conquérir le cœur de la belle Estella.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman adhère à la Nambla
programme.desc: Cartman en a marre des autres. Pour lui ils ne sont pas assez matures. Il décide de trouver des amis adultes sur Internet, mais tous ses amis se font envoyer en prison. Il va voir Mephesto pour avoir un ami artificiel.

programme.title: South Park: Tampons en Cheveux de Cherok
programme.desc: Kyle tombe gravement malade, et en ville tout le monde ne jure que par la médecine à base de plantes des indiens. La mère de Kyle refuse alors de faire hospitaliser son fils croyant qu'il ira mieux avec les plantes.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Pète les Plombs
programme.desc: Chef est scandalisé : le drapeau de South Park est selon lui raciste. Afin d'en juger avec la plus grande impartialité, il est demandé aux enfants de décider s'il faut changer ou non le drapeau.

programme.title: South Park: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt
programme.desc: Cartman décide de mettre à exécution le rêve qu'il vient de faire : monter un groupe de musique avec les autres garçons pour gagner '10 millions de dollars'.
programme.sub-title: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt

programme.title: South Park: Les handicapés vont-ils en enfer?
programme.desc: Le Pasteur décide de parler de l'enfer. Il fait alors peur aux enfants en leur disant que s'ils ne sont pas de bons chrétiens, ils périront dans les flammes de l'enfer. Les enfants, décident alors de devenir de bons chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: Probablement
programme.desc: Dans l'épisode précédent, les garçons découvrent le Pasteur en plein acte sexuel dans son église. Cartman décide de prendre les choses en main afin de remettre dans le droit chemin tous les enfants de la ville.

programme.title: South Park: CM1
programme.desc: C'est la rentrée. Les garçons arrivent en CM1, heureux de ne plus se faire taper par les grands du CM1. Mais ce sont désormais les CM2 qui les tapent. La nouvelle prof Mme Chrokelpaf, ainsi que la nouvelle façon de travailler les effrayent.

programme.title: South Park: Le Super Classeur
programme.desc: Cartman vient d'acheter un tout nouveau classeur avec toutes les fonctionnalités. C'est alors qu'un homme venu du futur le prévient que ce classeur peut envahir la planète. Le classeur est donc détruit, mais Cartman s'en rachète un le lendemain.

programme.title: South Park: Helen Keller! The Musical
programme.desc: Thanksgiving approche et comme tous les ans, les CM1 doivent jouer la vie d'Helene Keller. Butters s'est infiltré chez les maternelles et leur annonce que leur spectacle est superbe.

programme.title: South Park: Camp de Régime
programme.desc: Cartman est envoyé en Camp de Régime car tous ses proches trouvent que c'est mauvais pour lui d'être gros. Il décide alors de tirer profit de cette expérience, mais pas de la manière dont ses proches le souhaiteraient.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mot en M
programme.desc: Les enfants veulent aller voir un concert, mais les parents de Kyle refusent de le laisser y aller. Kyle décide alors de trouver un moyen pour se débarrasser d'eux. Cartman lui conseille d'appeler la police et de dire qu'il se fait maltraiter.

programme.title: South Park: Le Cycle du Caca
programme.desc: Cette année, les garçons ont peur de ne pas avoir de cadeaux de Noël. Les gens n'achètent plus. Kyle décide alors d'aller voir Mr Hankey pour l'aider a redonner l'esprit de Noël.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman doit mourir
programme.desc: Cartman voudrait être le premier de la bande à atteindre la puberté. Il achète donc des 'poils' 10 dollars à un garçon plus âgé, Scott Tenorman.

programme.title: South Park: Y'en a Dans Le Ventilo
programme.desc: La série Cop Drama va diffuser un épisode ou le mot 'Merde' sera prononcé. Dès lors une épidémie de peste se déclare.

programme.title: South Park: Combat d'Infirme
programme.desc: Al Super Gay est viré des scouts parce qu'il est gay. Et les enfants font la connaissance de Jimmy Valmer, un handicapé qui prend la vie avec humour. Mais Timmy est jaloux du succès de Jimmy, et un combat d'infirmes est engagé.

programme.title: South Park: Terrance et Phillip : de tempêtes en naufrages
programme.desc: Terrence et Phillip, les canadiens pétomanes, mettent fin à leur duo pour divergences créatives. Les garçons se mettent en tête de réunir leurs idoles.
programme.sub-title: Terrance et Phillip : de tempêtes en naufrages

programme.title: South Park: Cartman Land
programme.desc: Suite à la mort de sa grand-mère, Cartman hérite d'un million de dollars et réalise son rêve de toujours: il achète un parc d'attraction (dont il profite tout seul) qu'il rebaptise 'Cartmanland '.

programme.title: South Park: Du bon usage du preservatif
programme.desc: Les parents découvrent que leurs enfants sont très mal informés sur les choses du sexe. On demande à l'école de donner des cours. À croire que les parents ignorent qui sont les enseignants, Mme Crockelpaf, Mr Mackey et Mr Garrison.

programme.title: South Park: Servietsky
programme.desc: À peine les enfants ont-ils obtenu leur console Gamesphère qu'on leur enlève. Ils doivent livrer une serviette intelligente fumant des pétards a une organisation militaire. Seulement les gamins se retrouvent embrouillés dans une histoire.

programme.title: South Park: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul
programme.desc: Kenny, Cartman, Stan et Kyle sont envoyés par erreur en Afghanistan. Sur place et contre toute attente, ils vont s'apercevoir qu'ils ont beaucoup de points communs avec les enfants Afghans.
programme.sub-title: Oussama Ben Laden pue du cul

programme.title: South Park: Comment manger avec son cul
programme.desc: Cartman placarde la photo de Kenny associée à la mention 'Enfant disparu' sur tous les packs de lait du pays.

programme.title: South Park: L'Engin
programme.desc: Mr Garrison, ne supportant plus que ses vols d'avions soient annulés ou retardés, décide d'inventer un nouveau moyen de transport.Kyle est très embarrassé quand il reçoit la visite de son cousin de New-York, également prénommé Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Les riches debarquent
programme.desc: Se sentant rejeté, Token décide d'appeler d'autres riches. Mais les hommes de la ville ne supportent pas l'arrivée de ces riches.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Se Meurt
programme.desc: Cartman tente de sauver la vie de Kenny en suppliant le Congrès de faire reprendre la recherche sur les cellules souches.

programme.title: South Park: L'Episode de Butters
programme.desc: Butters fait quelques découvertes qui vont changer le cours de son existence. Son père est bisexuel et sa mère tente de le tuer. Heureusement tout s'arrange à la fin.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Maury Povich Show reçoit des personnes difformes et leur offre des cadeaux. Les gamins décident d'envoyer Butters au show avec des testicules en latex attachées au menton.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Vacances à Aspen. Les gamins ont des ennuis avec des ados fous de ski et les parents vont vivre l'enfer de l'arnaque.

programme.title: South Park: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip
programme.desc: Le visionnage d'une bande annonce se transforme en course contre la montre pour trouver une télé valable.
programme.sub-title: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip

programme.title: South Park: Le veau, c'est rigolo
programme.desc: Les enfants se soucient du sort des veaux qui sont en réalité des bébé vaches torturés.

programme.title: South Park: Professeur Chaos
programme.desc: Butters est exclu du groupe des gamins. Excedé, il s'invente un alter-égo maléfique, le Professeur Chaos. Pendant ce temps, Stan, Cartman et Kyle mettent en place une sélection pour trouver un remplaçant à Kenny.

programme.title: South Park: Les cathos, c'est chaud
programme.desc: Le père Maxi propose aux enfants de partir pour une croisière en compagnie de prêtres et d'évêques venus de tous les pays. Mais Randy raconte qu'il a entendu aux informations que les prêtres faisaient subir des mauvais traitements aux enfants.

programme.sub-title: The king of the Fishman Island! Neptune, the god of the sea

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: The Ryugu Palace! Taken by the shark they saved!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A trio of unsuspecting mermaids find themselves in hot water after releasing a bad guy from his barrel of a prison. Over at the royal palace, Luffy gets up close and personal with the Mermaid Princess!
programme.sub-title: A coward and a crybaby! The princess in the Hard Shell Tower!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's lightning reflexes spare the Mermaid Princess from a grisly death, Neptune's army attempts to apprehend the Straw Hats, and Captain Vander Decken forges a sinister undersea alliance!
programme.sub-title: It's an emergency! The Ryugu Palace is occupied!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With their backs against the wall, the Straw Hats are forced to take King Neptune and his men hostage. On the other side of the palace, Luffy and the Mermaid Princess make plans to visit the Sea Forrest!
programme.sub-title: The Ryugu Palace in shock! The kidnapping of Shirahoshi!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy accidentally "kidnaps" the Mermaid Princess, an old friend issues a grave warning to Chopper and Sanji, and the New Fish-Man Pirates prepare for a raid on Ryugu Palace!
programme.sub-title: Hordy's onslaught! The retaliatory plan set into motion!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Captain Vander Decken and Hordy Jones manage to successfully breach the defenses of Ryugu Palace. Meanwhile, Jimbei waits patiently for Luffy to arrive at the Sea Forest.
programme.sub-title: The battle in Ryugu Palace! Zoro vs. Hordy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Robin ventures into the forest in search of ancient secrets, Zoro takes to the water for a slicing, dicing showdown with Hordy Jones, and Luffy is branded a royal kidnapper by an angry mob of fish folk!
programme.sub-title: Keep Shirahoshi safe! Decken close behind!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Chopper, and Sanji are taken prisoner by a fish mob just as Vander Decken launches an attack the princess! Elsewhere, Zoro continues his battle with Hordy, and Nami hitches a ride on a mermaid to escape the crumbling palace!
programme.sub-title: The Straw Hats defeated?! Hordy gains control of the Ryugu Palace!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro and Neptune fight bravely, but they're no match for Hordy and his pill-popping minions. Back at the ship, Luffy reunites with Jimbei, who reveals something sinister about his past.
programme.sub-title: The haunting ties! Nami and the Fishman Pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The New Fish-Man Pirates continue their bloody and violent uprising, and Jimbei begins the story of how he unleashed the monster known as Arlong on the unsuspecting citizens of the East Blue.
programme.sub-title: A hero who freed the slaves! An adventurer Tiger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei continues his story with tales of fish-men taken as slaves, Queen Otohime's fierce devotion to her people, the legend of Fisher Tiger, and the sinister rise of Arlong.
programme.sub-title: KIZARU APPEARS! A TRAP TO CATCH TIGER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Arlong's violent tendencies are condemned by Fisher Tiger, and the arrival of a young human girl teaches the Fish-Man Pirates a lesson in compassion.
programme.sub-title: A Team is Formed! Save Chopper

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The great pirate Fisher Tiger keeps his promise to a young slave girl, but the adults in her village are determined to make him pay for his act of honor.
programme.sub-title: THE DEATH OF THE HERO! A SHOCKING TRUTH OF TIGER!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the wake of Fisher Tiger's tragic death, the once-mighty Sun Pirates are splintered by an ongoing quarrel between Jimbei and Arlong. Meanwhile, Queen Otohime's ceasless quest to help her people begins to take its toll.
programme.sub-title: THE SUN PIRATES SPLIT! JIMBEI VS. ARLONG!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Tensions run high when a slave-owning Celestial Dragon washes up on Fish-Man Island. His former captives cry for out for blood, but Queen Otohime sees it as a chance to mend fences between the gilled and non-gilled!
programme.sub-title: SHAKING FISHMAN ISLAND! A CELESTIAL DRAGON DRIFTS IN!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After an agonizing absence, Queen Otohime returns to her people with exciting news. Unfortunately, a horrific act of violence derails the queen's mission and changes life on Fish-Man Island forever.
programme.sub-title: A SUDDEN TRAGEDY! A GUNSHOT SHUTS DOWN THE FUTURE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Jimbei reaches the heartbreaking conclusion in the story of Queen Otohime, Nami does something completely unexpected, and Hordy Jones makes a foreboding appearance!
programme.sub-title: BACK TO THE PRESENT! HORDY MAKES A MOVE!

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The children learn more about the history of the minicons and the war. The latest minicon alert leads the team to a volcanic island: the volcano erupts in the middle of the usual 'Bot vs 'Con battle.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: he Decepticons gain access to the Autobot base, and attempt to take the other two minicons that, with the one Megatron captured on the island, combine to make the supremely powerful Star Sabre. Can Hot Shot save the day?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot proves himself very skilled with the Star Sabre, but the arrival of a new Decepticon proves him overconfident. The Decepticons acquire the first of another three combining minicons which transform into the ultimate form of defence.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A new minicon activates inside a highway tunnel, and the race is on to see who reach it first. Hot Shot is becoming more proficient with the Star Sabre. A new transformer arrives, claiming to be an Autobot, but Rad has his doubts.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Grabbing onto Megatron at the end of a battle, Hot Shot and Sideways are transported to the moon. The battle resumes, but Hot Shot is betrayed, and Starscream gains the Star Sabre.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the loss of the Star Sabre, the Autobots keep losing battles. In a fog-bound valley, Megatron plots to get the Sabre from Starscream, at the same time boosting his crew's confidence in himself. Scavenger's secret is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Autobots and Decepticons face off amongst snowy mountains in the battle for the latest minicon. Despite using the Star Sabre, this time Megatron loses - and Scavenger finally gains the Autobots' trust.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A weekend's camping trip to the valley below the dam goes wrong when a violent storm moves in. With Red Alert trapped in a mudslide, the sluice gates about to open, and local reporter Kelly filming, how will the Autobots escape detection?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Autobot Blurr joins the team, but proves himself not much of a team player. The Decepticons acquire the final minicon to create the Skyboom Shield, the most powerful defensive weapon in the universe.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Confident of his ability to finally overcome the Autobots, Megatron challenges Optimus to battle. However, when all seems lost Optimus' minicon summons the Skyboom Shield to protect his master.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron's plan to split up the Autobot team and defeat them individually fails when it's revealed that the minicons have their own, secret agenda.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Decepticons lose another battle: Megatron takes out his frustration on Starscream, beating him half to death for no reason. Sideways uses the situation to try to foment unrest and rebellion.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Trapped in cyberspace with Sideways, Alexis, Rad, Carlos and their minicons become aware of a massive evil entity, far more powerful and dangerous than Megatron, lurking threateningly in the background. Or was it all a dream?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A new transformer enters the solar system. On the moon, Thrust the master tactician arrives to assist Megatron in his battle against the Autobots, but all does not go according to plan.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Optimus damaged and temporarily out of commission, the newly-arrived Jetfire takes command - and seriously underestimates the Decepticons. But on the verge of defeat, Optimus reveals a new ability.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: On the moon, Thrust continues his plotting with Megatron. On earth, despite Jetfire saying he's one of the good guys, the kids are suspicious of Sideways - as are the Decepticons. And something huge and ominous is approaching earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The massive Tidalwave joins the Decepticons, but is, seemingly, defeated in battle by Hot Shot and Blurr. Alexis discovers three new minicons, which Sideways says combine to create another ultimate weapon, the Requiem Blaster.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The kids try to gather the three Requiem Blaster minicons together. Sky Blast at first resists, then sings the others to him to save Optimus. They all realise there's more to the minicons than first appears.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Understanding that the minicons want to be in charge of their own destinies, the kids sneak the new team out of the base. Thrust finds them, but so do the Autobots who save the day. It's agreed the minicons should not be forced to fight.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Enthusiastic young Sideswipe, Blurr's hero-worshipper, joins the team and Optimus tasks Hot Shot with training him. Wheeljack also arrives on earth, bent on revenge for Hot Shot seemingly abandoning him during a battle on Cybertron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Desperate to make amends to his old friend, Hot Shot allows Wheeljack to shoot him, but this isn't enough. Wheeljack takes Sideswipe hostage, but Hot Shot rescues him. On the moon, Megatron welcomes Wheeljack to the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron sacrifices Starscream, leaving him to face the Autobots alone while the Decepticons infiltrate the Autobot base to capture the Requiem Blaster. Smokescreen sacrifices himself to try to protect the Blaster minicons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hearing Megatron say he is nothing more than disposable cannon fodder, Starscream defects with the Star Sabre. To prove he's genuine, he gives the Autobots details of the moon base. Red Alert works on what's left of Smokescreen.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Starscream's help, the Autobots infiltrate the Decepticon moon base, attempting to rescue all the minicons Megatron has captured and forced into building a spaceship.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Alexis tracks a minicon in the vicinity of Mars. Starscream gets there first, but is disabled by Tidalwave. Jetfire rescues him: on the way back Starscream spots and tries to entice the minicon. But first they must get past Megatron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the kids befriending and welcoming him, the Autobots deeply suspicious of him, and driven by his need to kill Megatron, the deeply conflicted Starscream trusts Thrust and returns to the moon base with the Star Sabre and Skyboom Shield.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Sabre, Shield and Blaster together create the Hydra Cannon. Installed on their new ship, the Decepticons test it on a comet - then Megatron orders Starscream to use it to destroy the Autobot base. Problem is, that'll also destroy the earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Optimus and Jetfire attack the ship, but can't stop the Hydra Cannon being deployed. Optimus makes the ultimate sacrifice and takes the full blast. Afterwards only his minicon and his matrix are found, but at least earth survives.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot insists they should take vengeance on the Decepticons: Scavenger, with the support of the minicons, reminds him of their true purpose. With Hot Shot's realisation of the right way forward, Jetfire hands over command to him.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the Autobot ship ready to leave, Hot Shot, supported by the rest of the team, refuse to let the children accompany them. But then the minicons refuse to allow the ship to depart unless the kids are on board.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: As the Axalon chases the Decepticon ship, hundreds of minicons appear. The 'Cons turn back to fight, and the 'Bots seem doomed, but the minicons resurrect Optimus.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot and Red Alert are sucked through a wormhole. The minicons guide the Axalon to their location, where they are all attacked by Nemesis Prime. As the planet breaks up, the 'Cons shoot down the Axalon and escape.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The 'Bots reach Cybertron to find Megatron (now calling himself Galvatron) already winning the war. The minicons fend off an attack by Unicron, warning of great danger, but Galvatron believes it just an Autobot trick.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: While the battle continues, Hot Shot goes to Cybertron to try to convince Galvatron of the impending danger. Thrust's true allegiance and agenda is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Thrust flees into the depths of Cybertron, pursued by Hot Shot and Wheeljack - and, separately, Starscream, who saves the children from being killed. The children discover the origins of the minicons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Thrust joins Sideways by passing through a portal deep underground: his pursuers follow and find themselves on Cybertron's moon, which begins to disintegrate. To everyone's horror, Unicron is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: To convince Galvatron he must ally with Optimus to prevent Unicron taking over the universe, Starscream makes the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the Decepticons and Autobots allied, both armadas engage the planet-sized, transformed Unicron in battle in order to save Cybertron.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An emotional intervention on Dr. Phil's stage: Siblings Sarah and PJ say for the past two years their mom, Kim, chose alcohol and pills over her four children. With father Pete headed to prison for mail fraud in a few weeks, the family is falling apart.
programme.sub-title: Time Is Running Out For Prison-Bound Dad: Did His Wife Blackmail Him Into Embezzling $300,000

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sandra and ex-husband Joey admit they’re in a bitter custody battle. Sandra and Joey’s mudslinging has frightening accusations, but are they telling the truth? See what happens when these parents are offered polygraph and drug tests. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Bitter Custody Battle: Claims Of Poison In Ice Cream, A Child Wrapped In A Garbage Bag And Inappropriate Touching: What Will The Polygraph Reveal Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel says he and Lynsey are in a custody battle filled with lies and accusations and daughter Sophie, 4, is caught in the middle. Lynsey says after a visit with Daniel their daughter came home saying he hurt her. Dr. Phil sifts through the chaos. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Compulsive Lies, False Charges, & Coaching: A Dad's Fears About His Daughter's Safety At Mom's House Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.
programme.sub-title: Adopted Twin, Beaten, Strangled, Starved And Locked In A Room: The Exclusive Interview

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda, 25, says she was molested over 795 times by her father, Earl Nix, a secret when revealed to family was rejected despite Nix being convicted of first-degree criminal sexual conduct. The family comes face-to-face in an emotional attempt for truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues dialogue with Amanda who says she was sexually abused by her father, Earl Nix. Hear what Earl said to Amanda during a police-recorded phone call, which the jury heard. Amanda agrees to take a polygraph. Will the results convince? Part 2
programme.sub-title: Amanda's Secret: Lie Detector Results Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gina says her daughter, Alexis, 18, was "kidnapped" and "held hostage" by her survivalist boyfriend, David, 19, which Alexis and David deny. Mom Gina fears for Alexis's safety. David agrees he’s a survivalist who owns guns, but he's not dangerous. Part 1
programme.sub-title: I'm Afraid My Daughter Was Kidnapped By Her Survivalist Boyfriend Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Susie says she's at the end of her rope raising her 4-yr-old granddaughter & says daughter Adriana, 20, neglects her duties to spend time boyfriend Matt. Adriana strongly denies. Matt says he's judged for past drug use. Don't miss this emotional Dr. Phil.
programme.sub-title: I'm Raising My Granddaughter Because I Think My Daughter Is Violent, Abusive & Neglectful

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gina asked Dr. Phil for help with her daughter Alexis, saying she was kidnapped by her survivalist boyfriend David. As the story unfolds, another layer surfaces, allegations of molestation by a family member. Find out who, and will a polygraph tell all?
programme.sub-title: My Ex-Wife Claims I Molested Our Daughter Who Ran Off With Her Boyfriend Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jana & Allen say neighbors Maritha & Melanie moved into the neighborhood: police reports, DFS, threats & their 4 dogs bark all hours of the night! Maritha & Melanie point to Jana & Allen, with Melanie being charged with misconduct for mooning a neighbor!
programme.sub-title: Neighbor Feud Erupts With Constant Calls To The Police, False Allegations, Trumped Up Charges, And Threats Of Violence

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Calah Waskow, 15, made national news when allegedly abducted by her friend's 37-year-old dad. Issuing an Amber Alert, Calah was found five days later. What happened to her? Did she have a secret relationship with the older man? Calah tells her story.
programme.sub-title: 15-Year-Old Runs Away With Her Friend's Dad: The Amber Alert, The Search And The Rescue

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keirsten claims her boyfriend, Mike, has slammed her face into the car radio and repeatedly hit her in the head, giving her several black eyes and a bloody lip. Although Mike's been arrested twice for domestic battery, she loves him and he's a great dad.
programme.sub-title: Daughter's Boyfriend Has Been Arrested For Domestic Battery Twice But She Refuses To Leave Him

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Angie & Hannah who say step-father & step-grandfather Ralph routinely sexually abused them. For the first time in 15 years, Angie & Hannah are face-to-face with Ralph, who denies all claims. Is Ralph cleared by a polygraph test?
programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? The Polygraph Results Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Angie says stepfather Ralph routinely sexually abused her as a teen. Angie says that her stepfather didn't stop with her, he turned his attention, affection & sexual abuse toward her daughter Hannah. They say grandma Leta knew, yet looked the other way.
programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? What Did Grandma Know? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After former friends Randi & Haley tell Brittany's history of harassing men & faking pregnancies, Dr. Phil talks to Brittany and asks her to prove she is pregnant. What sent Brittany storming off stage? See the backstage conversation with Dr. Phil.
programme.sub-title: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: Brittany Speaks Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany wrote to Dr. Phil devastated to discover that her boyfriend, the man she loves & with whom she is having a baby, leads a double life. But Dr. Phil discovered that Brittany was leaving out important details. What his team uncovered is shocking!
programme.sub-title: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: What's Next? Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Haley adamantly claims she’s pregnant and about to give birth to Jesus, the Son of God. Dr. Travis Stork reveals the result of Haley’s ultrasound. Is she pregnant and giving birth in two weeks? How will Haley handle the truth if she isn’t pregnant? Part 2
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Believes She's Pregnant With Jesus: What Will The Ultrasound Show Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristi says daughter Haley has always been a compulsive liar. She says lies Haley has told are that she was a contestant on American Idol, rapper Eminem is her father and she’s diagnosed paranoid schizophrenic. Now she says she's 9 months pregnant. Part 1
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Is Delusional And Lying About Being 9 Months Pregnant Pt. 1

programme.sub-title: Police Called 100 Times On Our Car Stealing, Drug Taking, Dad Beating, Beautiful 15-Year-Old Daughter, Who Is Now Corrupting Her Younger Sister Pt. 1

programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Lies, Child Sex Abuse, And Stalking Pt. 1

programme.title: Barbed Wire
programme.desc: In 1878, Gene Autry is a cattle buyer who tries to settle a battle between the cattlemen and homesteaders, when the latter are worked up into a feverish pitch by unscrupulous landowner Steve Rutledge.

programme.title: Saginaw Trail
programme.desc: Gene Autry is sent to investigate the murders of settlers with the help of Smiley Burnette and two young homesteaders. Gene soon discovers that rich fur trader is behind the staged Indian raids.

programme.title: Hour Of The Gun
programme.desc: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Gene Autry arrives in Red Bluff to work on the investigation of mail robberies. U.S. Bonds are stolen, and Smiley finds burned fragments of them. A henchman confesses who the guilty party is.

programme.title: Home On The Prairie
programme.desc: Livestock inspectors Gene Autry and Frog Millhouse are accused of favoritism when they try to help an old rancher and his attractive daughter whose cattle appear have hoof and mouth disease and are doomed to be destroyed.

programme.title: Mountain Rhythm
programme.desc: Unscrupulous Pueblo Springs Valley resort owners wreak havoc for Frog’s Aunt Mathilda and neighboring ranchers in an effort to scare them off land recently placed for sale by the US Government.

programme.title: The Old West
programme.desc: Gene Autry tames and sells wild horses to a stagecoach line. His only competitor ambushes and shoots Gene, who is nursed back to health. A wild stagecoach race to test Gene's horses is arranged.

programme.title: Winning Of The West
programme.desc: Gene Autry protects a publisher and printer from some crooks who are using Indian raids to cover their bandit activities. When Gene's brother kills the publisher, Gene’s integrity is in question.

programme.title: Loaded Pistols
programme.desc: Seeking a man who has killed his best friend in a poker game, Gene Autry finds a cowboy hiding from a posse. The young man's gun is the murder weapon yet Gene is convinced of his innocence.

programme.title: Night Stage To Galveston
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Pat Buttram work for a newspaper publisher, and find evidence of corruption in the Texas State Police. The publisher’s daughter is kidnapped to prevent the story from being published.

programme.title: Apache Country
programme.desc: Cavalry scouts Gene Autry & Pat Buttram are ordered to break up a ring which uses raids to cover up its activities. Carolina Cotton assists Gene and Pat, while seeking revenge against the gang leader.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: When a sudden spurt of murders occurs in Texas Big Bend country, suspicion immediately falls on a young drifter who just moved to the area.
